answer: Recursive Graph Fee Escalation imposes a routing tax that scales exponentially with network density. Every transaction crossing a local trust bridge must pay a toll proportional to the number of incoming edges from unverified clusters. When an attacker spawns sybil nodes to farm rewards, each synthetic link triggers a compounding cost ripple across adjacent validator sets. This dynamic levy ensures that coordinating a fraudulent majority requires locking up capital at a rate faster than any single voyage can extract.
